rules: Every PackageVersion in Directory.Packages.props has exactly one entry here with the same id and version, and every entry has a PackageVersion (tests/ArcForges.Repository.Tests checks both directions).
contentHash is the NuGet content hash that every packages.lock.json records for the package; a changed hash is a new admission.
Transitive packages are pinned by the committed locks and reviewed with their direct parent; SDK-implicit packs (Microsoft.DotNet.ILCompiler, Microsoft.NET.ILLink.Tasks) follow the global.json SDK.
First-party packages are admitted only at a version whose publishing commit is an ancestor of the producer's main, and never at a version listed under neverAdmit.
Runtime packages of Native AOT executables must publish with zero trim and AOT warnings; an exception is recorded here as a decision, never suppressed in a project.
A change of id, version or hash updates the entry in the same pull request, with the reviewer's date and reason.

A NuGet restore warning accepted for a dependency graph is listed under nugetWarningExceptions with the project and package reference that carry the package-specific NoWarn, its evidence and its removal condition (tests/ArcForges.Repository.Tests checks both directions); no other project suppresses it.
